summary: Full backend regression via pytest (25/25 passing) + comprehensive UI e2e via Playwright on the demo tenant. Every endpoint listed in the review request and every data-testid flow was exercised.

minor.issue: CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=False, while login also sets an httpOnly cookie. Cookie-based auth from a different origin will not work; only Bearer works. Acceptable because frontend uses Bearer tg_token, but the cookie fallback is dead code cross-origin.
No lockout / rate-limit and no password strength beyond min_length=6 (explicitly OK per spec, listed only for awareness).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <option>. Cosmetic (visualEditor wrappers on option content). Not user-visible but pollutes console.

design_issues.screen: Job detail — SMS on jobs with no contact
issues: Backend correctly returns 400 'No customer contact number'; frontend logs it as a resource 400 in console. Consider surfacing a toast so users understand why SMS didn't send (currently only a resource error is emitted).

action_items: Optional: fix React hydration warning in Settings by removing the visual-editor <span> wrapper inside <option> tags for the currency <select>.
Optional: show a user-facing toast (error, not silent 400) when POSTing /api/sms/send returns 400 (e.g. missing contact number).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes cookie + Bearer auth but CORS has allow_credentials=False, so cookies are effectively unused across origins — either drop set_cookie or enable credentials with explicit origins.
All routes correctly scope by shop_id and clean() strips mongo _id — good.
SMS simulation returns simulated:true — matches spec.
Multi-tenant isolation verified: new account sees 0 jobs and dashboard total_jobs=0.
seed_data_creation: Registered several ephemeral tenants (test_*@example.com) for isolation/catalog/change-password tests; created TEST_ products and jobs on demo tenant and cleaned some up. Demo tenant now has ~66 jobs (added one via UI, one via API create/delete cycle).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses @example.com (not .test which pydantic email-validator rejects as reserved TLD). Currency select is native <select>, use page.select_option, not click+dropdown. Brand/Model in New Job modal are also native <select>. Login stores token in localStorage 'tg_token' and sends Bearer.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two cosmetic notes: (1) hydration warning caused by visual-editor <span> wrapper inside <option> in Settings.js currency select; (2) SMS 400 for jobs without contacts is correct backend behavior but the frontend does not surface a toast, so it shows as a silent console 400.
